problem: Production /index returns HTTP 200 and renders the home page (not a redirect) and logs 3 CSP violations 'Executing inline script violates script-src' per load. Branch fix/csp-index-alias (131e01a3) redirects /index to / but is not deployed.
impact: Duplicate-content URL stays indexable; inline scripts are blocked on that route; console noise.
fix: Merge and deploy fix/csp-index-alias, then confirm a 30x to /.
verification: curl -sI https://mythosatlas.com/index shows 30x with Location: /; no CSP errors in console.

location: https://mythosatlas.com/ (all pages), 390 viewport, light+dark, visual/home-fold-390-fresh.jpg, visual/quiz-quick-start-390-dark.jpg
problem: At 390 wide in a live viewport the sticky header is 89px tall and wraps to two rows: logo row, then search/language/theme icons left-aligned beneath with the right half empty. Full-page screenshots showed a single 43px row, so layout differs by capture mode.
impact: About 10% of a phone viewport is permanently consumed by chrome; the second row looks accidental.
fix: Keep logo and the three actions on one row at <=420px (shrink wordmark or right-align actions); find why wrapping triggers.

problem: ReactFlow family tree opens zoomed far out: node labels render near 5px and are unreadable. Minimap and zoom controls are bright white/grey blocks in dark theme.
impact: Feature is not usable without manual zoom; unthemed controls look unfinished.
fix: fitView with a minZoom floor and start focused on the page deity; theme minimap/controls with CSS variables.
verification: Load at 1440 dark: node text >= 11px, minimap uses theme tokens.

problem: Leaflet cluster popup is a bright white card with a black scrollbar in the dark theme. A world-zoom cluster of 70 opens a long list instead of zooming in. Map itself loads (8 tiles, 15 markers).
impact: Jarring contrast break on the only map; weak affordance.
fix: Theme .leaflet-popup to surface tokens, style the scrollbar, zoom into the cluster on click.
verification: Click a cluster in dark theme: dark popup with themed scrollbar.

problem: Journey cards Descent into Xibalba and Fishing Up the Islands use crude flat vector shapes (green blocks, blue wave, a stray letter) that clash with the painterly art on the other cards.
impact: Reads as placeholder art on an otherwise polished page.
fix: Replace with covers matching the other journeys, or use a styled fallback plate.
verification: All 8 journey covers share one art style.

problem: Cookie banner is semi-transparent: underlying text and map labels (HAUDENOSAUNEE) show through the banner copy. It covers bottom-centre content at 1440 and about a third of the viewport at 390.
impact: Reduced legibility; content obscured until a choice is made.
verification: Screenshot atlas with banner: no bleed-through.

problem: Aether Map: tradition labels collide with nodes (MESOAMERICAN clipped, CANAANITE overlapped) and the edges form a dense hairball with no dimming at rest.
impact: Orientation is hard; hero visual reads as noise.
fix: Offset labels radially, add label halo, lower resting edge opacity.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: Start/End year inputs wrap so End year sits alone on the next row. Axis labels (2000 BCE, 0 CE) are tiny and low contrast; 'No shared period recorded' repeats across rows.
impact: Filter controls look misaligned on phones; axis hard to read.
fix: Put both inputs on one row; raise axis label size and contrast; collapse empty rows into one note.
verification: 390 screenshot: inputs on one row, axis labels >= 11px.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: Greek tree repeats Poseidon, Hades, Demeter and Hestia twice in the right column (under Cronus and 'Also under Cronus').
impact: Reads as duplicated data and bloats the diagram.
fix: Render one node with a second parent edge, or mark repeats as ghost nodes.
verification: Each deity appears once per view.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: Choosing es/fr/de translates the nav but keeps <html lang='en'>, and the 'Open Menu' label stays English. The menu represents languages with country flags (US, Spain, France, Germany).
impact: Screen readers pronounce translated nav with English phonetics; flags misrepresent languages.
fix: Set document lang from locale, translate all aria labels, use language names instead of flags.

problem: Pronunciation control is a button whose only name is '[ZYOOS]': no aria-label or hint that it plays audio. In headless, clicking produced no audio element and speechSynthesis.speaking stayed false (headless has no voices, so actual sound is UNVERIFIED).
impact: Discoverability and accessible name of the audio feature are weak.
fix: Add aria-label 'Hear pronunciation of Zeus' and a speaker icon.
verification: Inspect accessible name; test in a real browser with sound.

location: Cmd+K palette on https://mythosatlas.com/, 1440, dark, visual/cmdk-thor-1440-dark.jpg
problem: Query 'thor' ranks Thor, Hathor, Anu (mid-word substring noise) above Sif and Thor's Journey to Utgard. ArrowDown+Enter from the highlighted first item lands on Hathor.
fix: Boost prefix and word-boundary matches over mid-word substrings.
verification: Query 'thor': top results all contain the word Thor or Thor-related myths.
resolution: PR #285 (744f81e2): mid-word matches score 10x weight; search-ranking.test.ts asserts Sif, Mjolnir, Megingjord rank above Hathor for 'thor'.

problem: Sample-issue page and story closers say 'the sign-up form is just below', but the only form is the small footer one, with an empty band in between (on mobile Characters/Places sit between).
impact: Primary conversion path under-emphasised; copy points at something not adjacent.
fix: Add an inline subscribe form under the issue and reword the nudge.
verification: Prominent form directly after the sample.
resolution: #283: /newsletter renders its own sign-up form (placement newsletter_page); 'just below' copy and self-link removed

problem: Support card disclaimer names the payee 'imKindaGeeky', an unexplained handle, in very small text. Stripe checkout deliberately not clicked.
impact: Unfamiliar name at the moment of trust.
fix: Use the site or person name, or explain the account; raise disclaimer size.
resolution: fix/support-copy: payee note at type-ui size, explains ImKindaGeeky as the Stripe account

problem: Mobile story end: 'Keep exploring' links wrap unevenly (Suggest a correction orphaned) and the translucent sticky header leaves a dark smudge over content. The closer itself renders cleanly.
fix: flex-wrap with a gap; opaque header background on scroll.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: 26 tradition chips wrap into 4 dense rows above the picker; on mobile the chip row is clipped at the right edge.
impact: Filter chrome pushes the comparison down.
fix: Collapse to a combobox with the top 6 chips.
verification: Compare fold shows picker, not chips.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.

problem: Home looks identical in light and dark above the fold because hero and large sections are always dark; only lower sections switch.
fix: Acceptable if intentional; otherwise lighten the hero in light theme.

problem: Image slots show flat navy squares until scrolled into view (lazy loading, no blur or skeleton). After scroll, 0 broken images on /deities, /pantheons, /creatures, /stories.
impact: Abrupt empty tiles on fast scroll.
fix: Add blurDataURL or a tinted skeleton.
verification: Throttled scroll shows a placeholder, not flat navy.
resolution: Fixed in PR #288 (squash 1a6f7219); visual check passed three runs in a row on the final head, threshold unchanged.
